text: 'Homotopy canonicity' for HoTT (Shulman, Coquand et al.) is the property that:
choices: Every closed type has a canonical form
Every closed term of type ℕ is definitionally equal to a numeral (even with univalence)
explanation: Homotopy canonicity: closed terms of type ℕ reduce to numerals; proved for CTT, open for book HoTT.
